spans.s:
mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Frightful, fearful, horrible, dreadful.
n. (-यं)
1 Fear, alarm, fright, dread.
2 The flower of the Trapa bispinosa.
E.
भी to be afraid, अच् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Terrifying, frightening.
E.
भय, and कारक what causes.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Fearful, formidable, frightful.
E.
भय fear, कृ to make, खच् aff.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Fearful, terrifying.
E.
भय, and द who or what gives.

mfn. (-र्शी-र्शिनी-र्शि)
Fearful, frightful.
E.
भय, and दर्शिन् appearing.

m. (-यः-या-यं)
Terrific.
E.
भय, and दाय what gives.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Routed, put to flight.
E.
भय fear, द्रुत flown, fled.

m. (-रः)
Removal of fear.
E.
भय, and प्रतीकार counteraction.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Causing or inspiring fear.
E.
भय, and प्रद who or what gives.

m. (-वः)
Season or occasion of alarm.
E.
भय, and प्रस्ताव occasion.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Put to flight.
E.
भय fear, भ्रष्ट fallen, gone.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
Alarming, fearful.
E.
भय, and विधायिन् causing.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Panick-struck.
E.
भय, and विप्लुत immersed in.

mfn. (-मा-मा-म)
Horrified.
E.
भय, संहृष्टरोमन् having the hair erect.

n. (-नं)
Seat or part exposed to peril or hurt.
E.
भय, and स्थान place.

n. (-तु)
Cause of alarm.
E.
भय, and हेतु cause.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Afraid.
E.
भय, and आतुर affected.

mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं)
Frightened, afraid.
E.
भय, and आर्त्त afflicted.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Frightful, formidable, terrific.
n. (-कं)
Terror.
m. (-कः)
1 RĀHU the personified ascending node.
2 A tiger.
3 The Rasa or sentiment of terror, as excited by poetical or dramatic composition.
E.
भी to fear, आनक Uṇādi aff.

m. (-हः)
A king, a sovereign.
E.
भय fear, अप before हा to quit, to oppose or remove from, aff. क.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Formidable, fearful.
E.
भय fear, वह to bear, aff. अच्, and आङ् prefixed.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Engrossed by fear.
E.
भय, एक alone, प्रवण bent.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Attended with or succeeded by fear.
E.
भय, and उत्तर subsequent.

m. (-मः)
Encouraging, allaying fear.
E.
भय, and उपशम tranquillising.
